_notes: Rosie's deck is sheet 176 (CardIDs 17600-17629) like Medusa's, the turtles' and the other Tales to Amaze / Witcher decks: only deck.identity tells them apart (docs/card-identity.md). The deck object holds 31 cards: the 30 playing cards and the hero card 402 (sheet 4, 5x2, index 2).

The bag also holds the loose card 17700 (CustomDeck 177, one image): 'Rosie The Riveter's Mech Suit', the rules card of the upgrade row. It is not a playing card and not the hero card; Houdini's hero card has the same CardID (17700) but another image (docs/card-identity.md).

The four upgrade tokens are Custom_Tokens with no nickname, double-sided (the main image is the inactive face, the child object the active face). `tokens` names them by their upgrade (data/heroes/overlay/rosie-the-riveter.json token_names): merlin_engine d670b6 (printed 1), cavity_magnetron e5ef35 (2), sedgley_fist_gun 85c49f (3), whizbang f45e71 (4). The engine keeps the state (counters upgrades and upgrade_shift); the bot's Rosie flips the tokens (and re-orders them per the row rule) and pings each, and says every change in the chat; a human Rosie flips her own (docs/heroes/rosie-the-riveter.md).

Rosie's miniature is the Custom_Assetbundle 862e16 and her dial the Custom_Model facfe3 (MAX_VALUE 15); Wendy's miniature is the Custom_Token 39768f and her dial the Custom_Model 45adc0 (MAX_VALUE 7).

merlin_engine.note: Z rotation of the upgrade token for each face: inactive (grey, the number 1-4 printed) = 0, active (colour) = 180, the same convention as Abe Sapien's Intuition tokens (confirmed live for those). Not yet checked live for these four. The bot flips each token and pings it (session_rosie, lua_rosie.set_upgrade_tokens).
